reading: The sketch lays out a zine-style landing page: a full-width black title band, then a ruled grid of bordered boxes (rotated 'LOUD' + intro copy, a blue duotone tile with yellow shapes, a tracklist, a pull-quote, credits text with a tilted red 'SOLD OUT SOON' badge, and a yellow price block), all tied together by typed notes that give exact copy, colours and placement.
